summary: Transaction Network Services (TNS) has been a wholly owned subsidiary of Koch (Koch Industries) since 2021, and operates as an Infrastructure-as-a-Service provider across three markets: Communications (call protection/authentication), Payments (payment acceptance, fraud prevention, device connectivity, orchestration), and Waypoint Trading Solutions (financial market connectivity); the company states 30+ years of industry experience and support across 60+ countries.

In payments, TNS provides device connectivity and payment orchestration infrastructure used by retailers, payment processors, and financial institutions — the network/connectivity layer that POS and payment terminals (including restaurant POS devices) rely on to reach card networks and processors.
